contract_notes: B1 CANON values remain unchanged; missing inputs are added only under simulation_model with explicit PROPOSED/PENDING provenance.
The simulator must read this BALANCE_MODEL.json and must not duplicate tuning numbers in Python.
Model-only results are not runtime verification.
The architecture contract is the live source for stable IDs, six weapon/six passive slots, separate boss-chest/artifact-offer IDs, unbounded active artifact effects and final-boss NO_CHEST policy.
The live content contract now sets weapon level 10 and passive rank 10 for synergy; this model uses that 10/10 gate while the runtime architecture's legacy 6/5 fields remain a reconciliation blocker.

The 30-minute schedule, ten ordinary IDs, ten elite catalog IDs, five active-elite bound and five ELITE_CHEST windows are synchronized to the current Architecture registry; their missing B1 absolute values remain explicitly PROPOSED/DERIVED. R2 structurally consumes this shape, but this numeric model still needs a fresh post-publication trace.

status_notes: Architecture contract is read-only input for this balance slice.

post_boss_reset_factor.source: PENDING_B1; user requires post-boss waves to restart below the preceding peak
post_boss_reset_factor.derived_formula: entry_budget = preceding_peak_budget × reset_factor; entry_cap = preceding_peak_cap × reset_factor
post_boss_reset_factor.rationale: A 20% reset below the preceding peak is large enough to make the breathing window visible while retaining continuity; exact reset remains a product/balance decision.

siege_duration_seconds.rationale: Reserves the last minute of each five-minute cycle for a stable peak/siege instead of an immediate boss transition.

ramp_curve.source: PENDING_B1; user requires monotonic low-to-peak pressure
ramp_curve.rationale: Linear interpolation is deterministic, auditable, and avoids a hidden step at the start of a new post-boss wave band.

density_formula.value: start_factor = reset_factor × entry_band_budget / peak_band_budget; fraction = clamp((run_elapsed - cycle_start - suppression_seconds - recovery_duration_seconds) / (cycle_duration - suppression_seconds - recovery_duration_seconds - siege_duration_seconds), 0, 1); effective_budget = lerp(entry_band_budget × reset_factor, peak_band_budget, fraction); effective_cap = round(lerp(entry_band_cap × reset_factor, peak_band_cap, fraction))
density_formula.source: B1 canonical band anchors plus post-boss reset decision
density_formula.derived_formula: entry is 80% of the preceding peak; the existing suppression+recovery window completes first; the remaining cycle time ramps to the next canonical band peak; fraction reaches 1.0 before the siege window
density_formula.rationale: Every post-boss cycle has a quiet recovery, then rises monotonically to the next band peak, and stays at peak for the siege window.

recovery_interaction.source: B1 section 4 boss interruption plus existing simulation model
recovery_interaction.derived_formula: effective_spawn_budget = density_curve_budget × boss_interruption_factor; suppression remains zero-spawn, then the existing 0.7-to-1.0 recovery applies
recovery_interaction.rationale: The immediate boss aftermath remains quiet without erasing the longer low-to-peak ramp.

record_provenance.source: PENDING_B1; REF_CONTENT_01 provides family roles but no absolute elite multipliers
record_provenance.derived_formula: each record multiplier is a proposed value applied to the linked ordinary base record; variant_hp = base_hp × hp_multiplier, variant_damage = base_damage × damage_multiplier, variant_speed = base_speed × speed_multiplier, variant_xp = round(base_xp × xp_multiplier)
record_provenance.rationale: The per-record values are explicit model inputs, not hidden test constants; every mapped elite family is covered while runtime activation remains capped at five.

pack_size.derived_formula: one anchor variant plus two ordinary escorts
pack_size.rationale: Small enough for a pressure beat and large enough to be visible.

cap_interaction.source: B1 active-cap invariant plus finite elite-pack requirement
cap_interaction.derived_formula: if active_count + pack_size > active_cap, remove the oldest ordinary active slots before inserting the finite pack; never exceed active_cap
cap_interaction.rationale: Makes every scheduled elite window a real bounded pressure event without allowing an elite pack to bypass the active cap or create spawn debt.

pack_settlement.source: 30-minute checkpoint boundary plus reserved five-window ELITE_CHEST cadence
pack_settlement.derived_formula: at the next main-boss checkpoint, clear any remaining finite-pack members before the main encounter and commit its one ELITE_CHEST offer
pack_settlement.rationale: Prevents a late 27:30 pack from suppressing its reserved 30-minute chest while preserving the main-boss clock freeze and active cap.

selection.source: B1 wave composition plus user elite-variation rule
selection.derived_formula: choose anchor base enemy from current band weights using run seed
selection.rationale: Keeps the elite overlay tied to the wave rather than inventing a hidden roster.

reward.source: FIRST_RUN_DATA_CONTRACT reserved ELITE_CHEST windows + B1 reward separation
reward.derived_formula: one offer after the linked finite elite pack is defeated; duplicate returns the committed offer without wallet mutation

max_active_records.source: REF-ARCH-02 max_active_variant_records plus current architecture registry cap
max_active_records.rationale: Keeps the runtime projection bounded at five active elite records while the ten-ID catalog remains addressable.

active_selection.source: REF-ARCH-02 runtime_projection_contract plus SYNC-03 Balance binding
active_selection.derived_formula: rank catalog IDs by SHA-256(selection_key + ':' + variant_id); keep at most registered_variant_cap, retaining one variant eligible for the current wave when possible
active_selection.rationale: All ten variants are addressable, but no elite window registers more than five IDs or mutates the permanent catalog.

combat_math.reference_damage_formula: raw_hit × hero_damage_multiplier × weapon_level_multiplier × passive_multiplier × profile_multiplier × critical_expected_multiplier
combat_math.synergy_damage_formula: base_dps × synergy_damage_multiplier, then clamp synergy_share ≤ 0.40 of total damage

boss_focus_fraction.source: PENDING_B1; player target allocation is not specified
boss_focus_fraction.derived_formula: boss_damage_share = total_attack_damage × boss_focus_fraction while a boss is active
boss_focus_fraction.rationale: A player can continue clearing nearby enemies while deliberately maintaining pressure on the boss; this avoids a fake single-target-only TTK.

weapon_level_damage_per_level.source: PENDING_B1; weapon level damage curve is absent
weapon_level_damage_per_level.rationale: A linear, bounded curve makes level gains visible without making the first six levels a runaway multiplier.

defense_reduction_per_meta_rank.rationale: Directly materializes the canonical +1% damage reduction per rank.

mitigation_cap.rationale: Prevents the proposed defense curve from reaching invulnerability while remaining explicit.

engaged_attacker_limit.source: PENDING_B1; arena collision/targeting limit is not specified
engaged_attacker_limit.derived_formula: incoming_damage = sum of at most engaged_attacker_limit landed attack events per step
engaged_attacker_limit.rationale: Two simultaneous landed events preserve a readable local threat while keeping both fresh heroes on a recoverable 30-minute path; the full active cap still measures CPU/occupancy pressure.

The simulator reports proposed-model results separately from CANON values.

crit_chance.rationale: Keeps Lin Yue stable at range without creating a crit identity.

crit_multiplier.derived_formula: standard expected-crit multiplier for model comparison
crit_multiplier.rationale: Provides a transparent expected-damage term; must be product-approved.

crit_chance.derived_formula: higher expected crit chance for a melee window build
crit_chance.rationale: Rewards proximity without making a single hit lethal.

crit_multiplier.rationale: Creates a measurable melee identity; must be product-approved.

damage_multiplier.source: derived from power rank 10

cooldown_multiplier.rationale: Uses the canonical M1 branch cap.

hit_probability.rationale: Max profile is a stress test for kill speed and overpowered synergy.

build_catalog.source: C1/C2 semantic content contracts + B1 combat/progression targets; every absent absolute is explicit PROPOSED or DERIVED

weapon_slot_limit.source: C1 live main; slots remain separate from level cap
weapon_slot_limit.derived_formula: build capacity is the number of simultaneous weapon records, independent of weapon level
weapon_slot_limit.rationale: Preserves the six-slot run build while adopting the live level-10 progression gate.

passive_slot_limit.source: C1 live main; slots remain separate from rank cap
passive_slot_limit.derived_formula: build capacity is the number of simultaneous passive records, independent of passive rank
passive_slot_limit.rationale: Preserves the six-slot run build while adopting the live rank-10 progression gate.

weapon_max_level.source: C1 live main §1; Stage 06 mockup still says level 6
weapon_max_level.rationale: Keeps the simulator aligned with the current content contract while preserving the 6/5 Architecture conflict as an explicit pending decision.

passive_max_rank.source: C1 live main §1; Stage 07 mockup still says rank 5
passive_max_rank.rationale: Keeps synergy eligibility data-driven and makes the conflicting architecture gate visible instead of silently using it.

max_synergy_claims_per_run.source: content catalog C1/C3 requested cap; architecture registry sync pending
max_synergy_claims_per_run.derived_formula: one claim per eligible non-final chest, capped at five run claims
max_synergy_claims_per_run.rationale: Allows the five mini/main chest windows to be meaningful without allowing unbounded evolution grants.

synergy_progression.derived_formula: one 10/10 pair consumes 10 paired level offers from weapon=1/passive=0; three pairs consume 30 offers and fit inside a level-40 run
synergy_progression.rationale: The existing one-track simulator could only represent one synergy. This explicit paired-offer rule makes three distinct 10/10 synergies mathematically possible without silently lowering the level-10 gate.

weapon_level_start.rationale: Preserves the current starting weapon state.

passive_rank_start.source: current balance simulator state; C1 does not specify initial rank
passive_rank_start.derived_formula: rank starts before the first passive offer
passive_rank_start.rationale: Requires exactly ten paired offers to reach rank 10, matching the requested 10/10 gate.

hero_lin_yue.source: C1 weapon→passive→synergy matrix; hero starter pair first
hero_lin_yue.derived_formula: starter synergy first, then deterministic content-catalog order
hero_lin_yue.rationale: Gives Lin Yue a ranged/control path while retaining three further eligible pairs.

hero_seoyeon_han.source: C1 weapon→passive→synergy matrix; hero starter pair first
hero_seoyeon_han.derived_formula: starter synergy first, then deterministic content-catalog order
hero_seoyeon_han.rationale: Gives Soyeon Han a mobility/close-area path while retaining three further eligible pairs.

minimum_pairs_for_target.rationale: Prevents counting repeated claims of one synergy as three synergies.
